BiblicalUsage: Mererah is bile, gall, the bitter fluid poured out in suffering. Job 16:13 says God's archers compassed him round about and poured out his gall upon the ground.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job's gall is the picture of suffering that goes all the way through a man and leaves nothing inside unpoured.
